ImageDescription.value:
NAL holdings: May 1934-
Mrs. Cruikshank in BAE Inf. says they regard this as a monthly CORRESPONDENCE and that we should not put some of the issues in other call nos., even in cases where are more than one issue for the month, one having a distinctive subtitle
